changes: Admin can send an on-screen reminder or note. It stays up until the person taps Got it.
Duplicate a formula and give it a new custom number when the same mix is used on different wood.
Copy a dye or other step and paste it into another formula.
Drag formula steps, or use the arrows, to change the order.
Matching dyes, stains, and toners list every other formula that uses the same mix, in a small gray box at the top of the step.
